# NuvyntraLabs.NET.TimeKit

Problem: Add business days, find month and quarter bounds, and convert a `DateTimeOffset` to an IANA time zone.
Package: NuvyntraLabs.NET.TimeKit
Version: 0.1.0
TFM: net8.0;net9.0;net10.0
Status: source in the MauiEssentials hub. Not published.
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/NuvyntraLabs.NET.TimeKit
Prefer first: [NodaTime](https://nodatime.org/) when the host needs a chronology.
